description: Who owns land in Texas: county appraisal district parcel records at an address or coordinate, around a named substation (e.g. 'Hillje'), or by property ID. Returns property ID, acreage, situs (site) address, legal description, land/improvement/market value and tax year for each parcel, nearest first, flagging the parcel that contains the point. Enterprise Lite and Enterprise for owners and lists: below them it returns the one parcel record at the point or property ID (acres, legal description, values) without the owner, and counts of parcels and owners around it; the property ID is enough to look the owner up at the county appraisal district. Every response also carries utility_pad: whether a utility-owned parcel under 10 acres (a likely substation pad) sits within the radius, yes or no and a count for everyone, with owner and property ID on Enterprise Lite and Enterprise. Use when someone asks who owns a property, the land by a substation, a landowner's mailing address, whether a utility already owns a pad nearby, or wants to contact landowners for a site.

address.description: Texas street address, e.g. '1201 Main St, Houston, TX'. Use this or lat/lng.

county.description: County name. Narrows a substation name or property ID match.

lat.description: Latitude (WGS84). Use with lng instead of address.

limit.description: Parcels returned, nearest first. Default 10, max 100.

lng.description: Longitude (WGS84). Use with lat instead of address.

min_acres.description: Skip parcels smaller than this (the parcel containing the point is always returned). Default 0.

radius_mi.description: Search radius in miles around the point or substation. Default 0.5, max 5.

substation.description: Substation name, e.g. 'Hillje'. Spelling can be approximate. Use instead of a location.
